job.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Senior Infrastructure Engineer

£65,000 - £72,000 + 10% Bonus
Manchester 

KDR are partnering with a globally recognised technology-led organisation to recruit a Senior Infrastructure Engineer into a highly skilled Technical Operations team.

This is an opportunity to join a business operating at the cutting edge of technology, where you'll be responsible for designing, building and operating the infrastructure that underpins complex technical services delivered on a global scale. Working across Linux, networking, automation, security and datacentre technologies, you'll play a key role in shaping the future of the organisation's infrastructure platforms.

For engineers who thrive on solving complex technical challenges and want exposure to large-scale infrastructure projects, automation initiatives and emerging technologies, this role offers a genuinely exciting technical environment.

The Role

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you'll combine hands-on engineering with project delivery, infrastructure design and technical leadership responsibilities.

Working within a specialist Technical Operations team, you'll spend the majority of your time delivering strategic infrastructure projects, driving continuous improvement and supporting the adoption of modern technologies. You'll also act as an escalation point for complex technical issues and provide guidance to junior engineers where required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement and support enterprise infrastructure platforms.
  • Administer and optimise Linux-based environments.
  • Drive infrastructure automation using Ansible and Infrastructure as Code principles.
  • Support datacentre deployments, hardware installations and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Troubleshoot complex networking, server and platform issues.
  • Contribute to infrastructure architecture and technical decision-making.
  • Maintain a strong focus on security, resilience and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with technical teams across the UK and internationally.
  • Support AI and high-performance compute infrastructure initiatives.

Current Projects

This role will provide exposure to several significant infrastructure programmes, including:

  • Major datacentre expansion and modernisation projects.
  • Migration away from legacy virtualisation technologies.
  • Development of GPU-powered AI infrastructure.
  • Global platform deployments across multiple international locations.
  • Security-focused infrastructure initiatives supporting emerging technologies.

What We're Looking For

We're keen to speak with experienced infrastructure professionals who have worked within datacentre, hosting, platform engineering, MSP or technical operations environments.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Strong Linux administration experience (Ubuntu, Debian, RHEL or similar).
  • Infrastructure automation using Ansible.
  • Hands-on datacentre and physical infrastructure experience.
  • Strong networking knowledge covering routing, switching, firewalls and VPN technologies.
  • Experience supporting enterprise server and storage environments.
  • Scripting experience using Bash, Python or similar.
  • Experience supporting virtualised infrastructure.
  • Containerisation knowledge, ideally Docker.
  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical challenges.

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Kubernetes.
  • Infrastructure security and hardening.
  • Git and version control systems.
  • Monitoring and logging platforms.
  • AWX or Ansible Automation Platform.
  • GPU infrastructure or high-performance computing environments.
  • Security tooling and vulnerability management exposure.

What's on Offer?

  • Salary of £65,000 - £72,000.
  • 10% annual bonus.
  • Hybrid working model.
  • Exposure to a broad range of modern infrastructure technologies.
  • Opportunity to work on large-scale, business-critical projects.
  • Involvement in AI and next-generation platform initiatives.
  • Collaborative, technically focused engineering culture.
  • Strong opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Additional Requirements

  • Must hold current SC Clearance or be eligible to obtain it.
  • Full UK driving licence preferred.
  • Willingness to travel to datacentre and office locations as required.
  • Ability to attend sites in the Greater Manchester area when necessary.

If you're a hands-on infrastructure engineer with strong Linux, networking and automation experience and are looking for an opportunity to work on complex, technically challenging projects in a highly skilled environment, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Product Owner - Data

Data Product Owner (SaaS)

Location: Leeds (Hybrid: 2–3 days per week in-office)

Salary: Up to £60,000 basic

Reporting to: Head of Data

 

A global SaaS innovator is looking for a commercially minded, value-driven Data Product Owner to take charge of a complex product roadmap and transform a massive backlog into high-impact deliverables.

 

Working closely with global clients and technical data squads, you will bridge the gap between deep technical capability and clear commercial return.

 

The Mission

Your focus is straightforward: cut through the noise, ruthlessly prioritize, and deliver immediate and long-term value. You won’t just manage tickets. you will shape the product vision, validate feature requests directly with clients, and ensure the engineering team builds the right solutions at pace.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Value-Driven Prioritization: Triage, refine, and structure a massive backlog, mapping every feature directly to measurable business and client value.
  • Roadmap Ownership: Collaborate directly with the Head of Data and executive stakeholders to define, adapt, and execute a transparent product roadmap.
  • Client & Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the primary technical voice for external enterprise clients, translating complex requirements into actionable user stories and clear release plans.
  • Agile Execution: Lead sprint planning, grooming, stand-ups, and retrospectives within a dynamic, fast-paced data and software engineering environment.
  • Metric Definition: Define and track product success metrics (KPIs/OKRs) to validate feature adoption and ROI post-launch.

 

What You Bring

  • Proven experience as a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager within a SaaS, Data, or Digital platform environment.
  • Exceptional prioritization framework experience (e.g., WSJF, MoSCoW, RICE) with a track record of decluttering legacy backlogs.
  • Strong client-facing skills with the ability to confidently push back, manage expectations, and discover genuine client needs.
  • Fluency across technical ecosystems (Engineering, Analytics, or AI-driven platforms) to converse effortlessly with Engineers.
  • Comfort operating in an evolving, high-tempo Agile environment where priorities can shift quickly.

 

The Setup

  • Location: Modern Leeds hub with collaborative spaces (hybrid model: 2–3 days on-site, remainder remote).
  • Leadership: High visibility, reporting directly into the Head of Data with direct input on strategic product architecture.

 

To apply or discuss the role in confidence, submit your CV or reach out directly for a brief discovery call.

  • Bridge Tech & Business: Translate complex business requirements from supply chain and manufacturing teams into resilient architectural blueprints.
